newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria shares lifted by Flughafen, seen advancing.
newsitem.headline: Austria shares lifted by Flughafen, seen advancing.

text.p: Austrian shares clawed back early losses to end in positive territory on Thursday, due mainly to a reversal of fortune in Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien, and traders said the ATX index was bound for 1,100 points.
The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares closed at 1,085.79 points -- 5.68 up on the day and 10.68 off the session low.
Flughafen Wien topped turnover, ending 1.6 schillings up at 495.6 on 119,000 lots. Earlier it slumped to a fresh year low of 473 schillings on heavy selling pressure.
"Money suddenly started flowing in when the ATX was trading at the low. It was a very positive session and we broke through a trend line at around 1,080 points," said a trader.
"The change in the general mood coincided with the turnaround in Flughafen," said a second trader.
Overall 17 shares closed up, three down and one unchanged.
Industrial group Radex-Heraklith was the top gainer, up 2.03 percent, or 6.4 schillings, at 321.9.
Papermaker Leykam was the biggest decliner, down 0.7 percent, or two schillings, at 284 schillings.
December ATX futures stood 8.0 points up at 1,089.0. The broad-based Vienna bourse index was 1.27 points up at 415.01.
